description: v3 defaults --new-bundle-format=true, which requires the OCI 1.1 referrers API.
Adopting it changes the on-registry signature format, so existing `cosign verify`
invocations against already-published images would need to change too.
Revisit as a deliberate upgrade once the verification story is settled;
raise or drop allowedVersions at that point. See PRs #49 and #62.
Held while v7 settles; the repo pins the v6.1.0 digest and nothing here needs
v7. Revisit deliberately rather than via an auto-raised major PR.
